pages.title: Two Collecting Bottles
pages.text: The durable bottle lasts 1,024 uses and does not stack. Disposable bottles stack to 16 and are consumed on use.

pages.title: Gather at the World's Edge
pages.text: In any dimension, move below minimum build height or above maximum build height and use the bottle on open air. Primordial Qi enters the inventory first, then personal storage if the inventory is full.

pages.title: Primordial Qi
pages.text: Use it on an entity to shrink that entity out of existence over 10 ticks, without counting as a player kill. If a matching spawn egg exists in the registry, one drops. Servers may deny selected entity types.

pages.title: Limits and Exceptions
pages.text: Primordial Qi is disabled during tribulation so it cannot bypass the trial. Removing the Ender Dragon still completes the vanilla dragon flow. Modded entities work too, but no substitute item is invented when they have no registered spawn egg.

pages.title: Another Trace of the Jade
pages.text: Besides initial grants, crafting and village chests, Ancient Jade may appear in vanilla suspicious sand or suspicious gravel archaeology loot, at 5% by default.
